review_focus: Opening a Schaubild enters exactly one workspace; no compact/fullscreen product state or Fullscreen API path is reintroduced.
The outer workspace, editor iframe and Native stage remain viewport-filling; tools, export, status and Native controls remain overlays rather than layout-reserving chrome.
Legacy host gutters remain removed while Legacy keeps its own editor and its real export capabilities instead of inheriting Native-only behavior.
Engine capability truth remains asymmetric: Native exposes Canvas/source-or-original plus SVG and no PNG; Legacy exposes Projekt, PNG and SVG.
Choosing an export closes the Export details popover before export while the prepared download remains reachable without changing stage geometry.
Native editing remains contextual and collapsible, with zoom, fit and reset reachable on desktop, tablet and mobile.

The earlier historical self-review claim that a uniform 48 px fit margin protects all overlay chrome is explicitly superseded: 48 px remains the standalone Native margin, while embedded Native fit uses asymmetric top=60, right=48, bottom=104, left=48 insets.

Real-browser clearance is measured in host coordinates, not inferred from iframe dimensions: host-chrome clearance is 56.10 px desktop, 48.73 px tablet and 53.97 px mobile; Native-toolbar clearance is 50.10 px, 42.73 px and 43.97 px respectively.
The fit math keeps numeric padding backward-compatible while adding bounded asymmetric inset support for the embedded product path.
The new browser regression uses a deliberately tall graph and asserts at least 8 px clearance from host chrome and at least 6 px from the Native toolbar after fit.
Legacy light/dark readback remains visually unchanged and full-workspace after the Native-only hosted-fit correction.
The immutable fit-clearance successor supersedes exactly four implementation/test paths and chains to the prior max-canvas acceptance without rewriting it.
Publication precedence verifies current hashes through the fit-clearance successor first and retains the prior max-canvas successor for all other accepted paths.
No new external origin, persistence authority, privilege, provider dependency, cross-repository write, runtime deployment or image-production path is introduced.
The clean fit-clearance evidence head passes Ruff, compile, registry validation, git diff hygiene and all 1659 repository tests.

iterations.finding: The original product issue was persistent chrome and Legacy gutters consuming workspace, not a missing browser Fullscreen implementation.
iterations.resolution: Kept one workspace state, removed dynamic dock/gutter mechanics and moved host plus Native controls to compact overlays while retaining an explicit Zurück action.

iterations.finding: Overlaying Native controls introduced a fit-to-content collision risk; the first implementation used a uniform 48 px fit margin.
iterations.resolution: Kept the 48 px standalone margin but later re-opened this assumption after review showed that it covered only iframe-internal chrome.

iterations.finding: Maximizing Native and Legacy together could accidentally erase real engine capability differences.
iterations.resolution: Preserved explicit export truth: Native Canvas/source/original plus SVG and no PNG; Legacy Projekt plus PNG and SVG.

iterations.finding: The Export popover remained visible after a successful export and unnecessarily covered the canvas.
iterations.resolution: Close the containing details element before export while keeping the resulting download reachable in the same compact workspace bar.

iterations.finding: Changing accepted product/test bytes invalidated historical source bindings, but those historical receipts must remain immutable.
iterations.resolution: Added digest-bound max-canvas acceptance and exact publication precedence rather than rewriting historical receipts.

iterations.finding: PR review thread PRRT_kwDOTGqvHc6o8b6l correctly identified that uniform VIEWPORT_FIT_PADDING=48 did not account for the outer host status pill plus workspace bar and that the existing browser test did not measure content clearance.
iterations.resolution: Extended fitView with backward-compatible asymmetric insets; embedded Native uses top=60/right=48/bottom=104/left=48. Added a tall-graph browser regression measuring fitted content against both host chrome and iframe toolbar. Exact-head readback proves positive clearance on desktop, tablet and mobile.

iterations.finding: The first clearance browser harness revision used nested requestAnimationFrame waits that can stall under Chrome virtual-time mode and produced no pass/fail marker.
iterations.resolution: Kept the geometry assertion unchanged and replaced only the harness wait with a virtual-time-compatible 20 ms timer; the resulting exact-head browser regression passes 3/3.

iterations.finding: The fit-clearance product change invalidated four bindings in the previous immutable max-canvas acceptance.
iterations.resolution: Created a separate fit-clearance acceptance successor for exactly those four paths, bound the review finding and measured clearances, and passed the publication gate plus full 1659-test validation on the evidence head.
